name: Slack Code
desc: Coding agents working in Slack channels, reviewed by the team.
desc_zh: 在 Slack 频道里协作的编程智能体，团队可审阅
solves: A coding agent's work is invisible until review. Here the agent writes in a channel, so review happens where the discussion already is.
solves_zh: 编程智能体的工作在审阅前是看不见的。这里它在频道里写，审阅就发生在讨论已经在的地方。
best_for: Your team reviews code in Slack and you want the agent in that loop, not in a separate tool.
best_for_zh: 你的团队在 Slack 里审代码，你想让智能体在这个回路里，而不是另开一个工具。
